name: roleplaying-agents git prune
goal: Reclaim ~100 GB of unreachable objects in roleplaying-agents .git and trim the local LFS store, with stashes pinned as refs, a verified --no-local mirror backup, operator review of unreachable revisions, and all repo users stopped; gc runs with reflog expiry disabled (keeps stashes); no rewrite, no push.

tasks.name: Snapshot, pin stashes, mirror backup (P1)
tasks.description: No tests required: backup with built-in verification; no code. Exact commands: human plan Task 1 Steps 1, 1b, 1c, 2-4. Broken refs removed (1c) BEFORE mirror: first mirror attempt failed 'upload-pack: not our ref 0000…'; operator chose A. Never reflog expire; avoid guard words.

steps.description: Record refs, stash count (6), worktrees, count-objects, du, df to /private/tmp/ra-prune
Pin stash@{1..5} as refs/stash-keep/1..5 via update-ref
cat + rm the 2 'checkpoints (1)' loose ref files (quoted); find <dir> -type d -empty -delete; for-each-ref stderr has no 'broken name'
Verify mirror: fsck --connectivity-only + per-namespace ref counts equal (heads/tags/ironclaude/stash/stash-keep/original) + du
find -xdev -samefile for the catalog db second hard link in ~/Code and ~/.codex

tasks.name: Delete broken and catalog-pinning codex refs (P2)
tasks.description: No tests required: ref deletion verified by listing and blob reachability. Exact commands: human plan Task 2 Steps 1-3. Broken refs already removed in Task 1 Step 1c (confirm only); valid codex refs reaching blob f121f0d2318612b179b7d532a357b773b444fa82 deleted via update-ref -d (set computed at execution time).

steps.description: Confirm broken refs gone: for-each-ref stderr has no 'broken name'
Loop refs/codex: DELETE those whose rev-list --objects reaches f121f0d2...; KEEP others

steps.expected: 0; if nonzero and hits come only from refs/stash-keep/* record and continue; any codex ref hit = stop

tasks.name: Unreachable-object review (P3)
tasks.description: No tests required: read-only listing + operator decision. Exact commands: human plan Task 3 Steps 1-3. fsck --connectivity-only --unreachable (reflogs count as reachable; matches gc with reflog expiry never); revision objects filtered by /^comm/ prefix.

steps.description: Unreachable revisions with date/author/subject, newest first; head 30 + tail 3
AskUserQuestion: rescue none/prune (Rec.) | rescue some | stop; rescued -> update-ref refs/rescue/2026-10-12-<n>

tasks.name: Stop users, gc, LFS prune (P4, P5)
tasks.description: No tests required: operational prune with gates and dry-run. Exact commands: human plan Task 4 Steps 1-4. Operator stops sessions; gates pgrep ChatGPT/git empty, no tmux pane and no lsof -d cwd (all processes, no -c filter) under roleplaying-agents; fresh refs-prestop snapshot. gc with -c gc.reflogExpire=never -c gc.reflogExpireUnreachable=never. NO reflog expire.

steps.description: AskUserQuestion stop users; gates (pgrep -lx ChatGPT, pgrep -lx git, tmux list-panes paths, lsof cwd); refs-prestop snapshot
steps.expected: All gates pass else wait; snapshot taken.

steps.description: gc with reflog expiry never + --prune=now (background, timeout 7200000); then count-objects, du, df
steps.command: git -C /Users/roberthyatt/Code/roleplaying-agents -c gc.reflogExpire=never -c gc.reflogExpireUnreachable=never gc --prune=now > /private/tmp/ra-prune/gc.log 2>&1; echo "gc exit=$?" >> /private/tmp/ra-prune/gc.log

tasks.name: Verify, record, release (P6)
tasks.description: No tests required: verification and documentation. Exact commands: human plan Task 5 Steps 1-3.

steps.description: fsck --connectivity-only; refs-prestop vs refs-after identical; refs-before vs refs-after recorded (expected: Task 2 deletions, stash-keep/rescue additions, pre-stop codex churn); stash list 6 and stash reflog 6; worktree list unchanged
Append 'Prune results'; stage; keep /private/tmp/ra-prune; tell operator to restart sessions
